2. In a large pot, bring water to a boil. Add the snails and boil for about 10 minutes to remove the slime. Drain and rinse them again.
3. In a large pan or wok, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and chopped onion. Sauté until the onions become translucent.
4. Add the cleaned snails and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until they start to turn a bit crispy.
5. Pour in the soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Stir well. Add the bay leaf and chili pepper. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Reduce the heat to low and let the snails simmer in the sauce for about 15–20 minutes. Stir occasionally.
7. Serve as a pulutan or with steamed rice.

Short Description: Pork adobo with hard-boiled eggs absorbing a savory-tangy soy-vinegar sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 45 minutes
Overall Time: 55 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/2 kilogram pork belly (liempo)
- 3 cloves garlic
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons vinegar
- 2 bay leaves
- 1/4 tablespoon whole peppercorns
- 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
- 1/2 teaspoon sugar, optional
- 1/2 cup water, or as needed
- 2 hard-boiled eggs
Steps:
1. Heat a pan and put the pork cuts. Sauté the pork until lightly browned and the oil starts to render.
2. When the oil starts to render, make a space at the center of the pan. Sauté the garlic for a few minutes, then sauté it together with the pork.
3. Add the soy sauce, whole peppercorns, bay leaves, and ground black pepper. Pour enough water to cook the meat. Cover the pan and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes until the pork is tender. Add more water if necessary.
4. Check if the pork is tender. Add the vinegar and sprinkle with sugar. Do not stir yet and let it simmer for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, stir gently and simmer for a few more minutes until the sauce is reduced.
5. Add the peeled hard-boiled eggs and stir to coat them with the sauce.
6. Remove the eggs and sauce from the pan. Set aside. Increase the heat and cook the pork until it starts to caramelize.
7. Remove some of the rendered oil if desired. Put the eggs and sauce back into the pan and stir gently.
8. Transfer the adobong baboy at itlog to a serving plate and serve with hot steamed rice.

Short Description: A hearty adobo combining chicken and pork in a rich soy-vinegar sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/2 tablespoon oil
- 1/2 onion, peeled and thinly sliced
- 1/3 head garlic, peeled and minced
- 1/2 pound pork shoulder or pork belly, cut into 2-inch cubes
- 1/2 pound chicken, cut into serving pieces
- 1/3 cup vinegar
- 3 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1/3 cup water
- 1 bay leaf
- Salt and pepper, to taste
Steps:
1. In a wide pan over medium heat, heat oil. Add onions and garlic and cook until softened.
2. Add pork and cook, turning as needed, until lightly browned. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 7 to 10 minutes.
3. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and the juices run clear.
4. Add vinegar and bring to a boil, uncovered and without stirring, for about 2 to 3 minutes.
5. Add soy sauce, water, and bay leaf. Continue to boil for about 2 to 3 minutes, skimming any scum that floats on top.
6. Lower the heat, cover, and cook for about 30 to 40 minutes or until the meat is tender and the sauce is reduced.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

Short Description: Boiled balut cooked adobo-style in soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Overall Time: 35 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 balut eggs, peeled
- 1/2 teaspoon sugar
- 1 1/2 tablespoons oil
- 1 clove garlic, finely minced
- 1/2 small onion, chopped
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 1 1/2 bay leaves
- Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
- Thinly sliced scallions, for garnish
Steps:
1. Remove the balut egg shells, then set aside.
2. Heat the oil in a frying pan. Sauté the onion and minced garlic until the oil is infused with the flavor of the garlic.
3. Add the balut and fry for a few seconds. Add the soy sauce and vinegar to the pan.
4. Bring to a boil without stirring. Simmer for a few seconds, then swirl the pan so that the eggs are coated with the sauce.
5. Add the bay leaves, sugar, and freshly ground black pepper.
6. Simmer for another minute. Swirl once more, then turn off the heat. Let sit for about 10 minutes.
7. Give the eggs a final swirl and serve with garlic fried rice.

Short Description: Shredded pork adobo fried until crisp and savory, great for breakfast with rice and egg.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 5 minutes
Cooking Time: 10 minutes
Overall Time: 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 3/4 pound pork adobo, sauce removed
- 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic
- 1 tablespoon oil
- A dash of ground black pepper
- 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce or Worcestershire sauce
- 2 cups garlic fried rice
Steps:
1. Shred the pork adobo meat by hand. Pull the threads of the pork slices until all the pork is shredded. Set aside.
2. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan.
3. Once the oil starts to get hot, add the minced garlic. Make sure the oil is not too hot so the garlic does not burn easily. Continue cooking the garlic until it turns light brown. Remove the garlic and set aside.
4. Using the remaining cooking oil, add the shredded pork adobo to the pan. Cook for 1 minute, tossing occasionally.
5. Add the soy sauce or Worcestershire sauce and ground black pepper. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
6. Transfer the cooked pork adobo flakes to a serving bowl and top with the fried garlic.
7. Serve with garlic fried rice.

Short Description: Pork simmered in salty shrimp paste with tomatoes and garlic for a bold, savory dish.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 35 minutes
Overall Time: 45 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/3 kilogram pork (pork belly, pork shoulder or pork butt), cubed
- 4 cloves garlic, crushed
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 1/2 cup water
- 2 cloves garlic, crushed
- 1/2 small onion, chopped
- 2 teaspoons bagoong shrimp paste
- 1/2 teaspoon peppercorns
Steps:
1. In a pan, put together the pork, garlic, vinegar, and water. Simmer for 30 minutes.
2. Drain the pork and reserve the broth. Sauté the garlic and onion.
3. Add the bagoong and cook for 5 minutes.
4. Add the pork, reserved broth, and peppercorns. Simmer until the pork is tender.
5. Serve hot with rice.

Short Description: A savory Filipino sisig made with pork belly, chicken gizzards, and chicken liver, mixed with onions, chili sauce, and mayonnaise.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 350 g pork belly
- 250 g chicken gizzards
- 50 g chicken liver
- 2 cups water (500 ml)
- 2 cloves garlic, crushed
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 1 thumb-sized piece of ginger, minced
- 1 tablespoon mayonnaise
- 1 1/2 tablespoons chili sauce
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon calamansi juice
- 1 spring onion, chopped
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
- 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/4 cup butter
- 1 egg
Steps:
1. Bring the water, garlic, salt, and black pepper to a boil in a pot.
2. Cut the pork belly into strips. Add it to the pot and simmer, covered, for about 1 hour.
3. Add the chicken gizzards and simmer for another 45–50 minutes, or until tender.
4. Drain the meat. Grill the pork and gizzards until lightly charred and cooked through.
5. Let the meat cool slightly, then chop it into small pieces.
6. Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and ginger and cook until the onion softens.
7. Add the chicken liver and mash it while cooking until it is fully cooked.
8. Add the chopped pork and gizzards. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
9. Add the chili sauce, garlic powder, soy sauce, and calamansi juice. Mix well.
10. Stir in the mayonnaise.
11. Crack the egg on top and cook until it is fully set.
12. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot with the optional lime wedges.

Short Description: A Filipino pork leg dish boiled until tender and deep-fried until the skin becomes crispy, served with a soy sauce and vinegar dip.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small pork leg (pata), about 1–1.5 kg
- 3 dried bay leaves
- 1 tablespoon whole peppercorns
- 2 pieces star anise (optional)
- 1 tablespoon salt
- 1 teaspoon ground black pepper
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 6 cups water (1.5 liters)
- 3–4 cups cooking oil, or enough to submerge the pork

For the Dipping Sauce:
- 1/2 cup white vinegar
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1 small red onion, minced
- 2 cloves garlic, crushed and chopped
- 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
- 1 teaspoon sugar
Steps:
1. Pour the water into a large pot and bring it to a boil.
2. Add the bay leaves, whole peppercorns, star anise, and half of the salt.
3. Add the pork leg and simmer for about 1 hour, or until tender.
4. Carefully remove the pork leg and let it cool. Drain it well and pat the skin completely dry.
5. Rub the pork with the remaining salt, ground black pepper, and garlic powder. Let it stand for 15 minutes.
6. Heat the cooking oil in a large, deep, heavy pot. Keep the pork dry before frying, and use a pot large enough to reduce the risk of oil overflowing.
7. Carefully lower the pork into the hot oil using long tongs. Fry until the skin is golden and crispy, turning carefully as needed. Keep a safe distance because hot oil can splatter.
8. Remove the pork and let the excess oil drain on a rack.
9. To make the dipping sauce, combine the vinegar, soy sauce, onion, garlic, black pepper, and sugar in a small bowl.
10. Serve the crispy pata hot with the dipping sauce.

Short Description: Tender pork leg in a sweet and savory sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small pork leg (pata), about 1–1.2 kg
- 1/2 pork broth cube
- 1/2 bunch pechay
- 5 pieces shiitake mushrooms
- 1 small carrot, sliced
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1/2 tablespoon cornstarch
- 1 piece star anise
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 teaspoon whole peppercorns
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 4 cups water (1 liter)
- 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil
- Salt and ground black pepper, to taste
Steps:
1. Bring 2 1/2 cups of water to a boil. Add the bay leaf and pork leg. Boil for 10 minutes, then drain and set the pork aside.
2. Heat the cooking oil and sesame oil in the same pot. Sauté the onion and garlic until the onion softens.
3. Add the boiled pork leg and sauté for 1 minute.
4. Add the soy sauce and the remaining 1 1/2 cups of water. Bring to a boil.
5. Add the pork broth cube and star anise. Cover and pressure-cook for about 20 minutes, or until the pork is becoming tender. Follow your pressure cooker's instructions.
6. Add the brown sugar, shiitake mushrooms, and carrot. Cook for about 3 minutes.
7. Add the pechay and cook for 1 minute.
8. Mix the cornstarch with 1/4 cup water until smooth. Pour it into the pot while stirring, then cook until the sauce thickens.
9. Season with salt and ground black pepper to taste. Serve hot with rice.

Short Description: Sweet cured pork cooked in pineapple juice and soy sauce until tender and caramelized.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour
Marinating Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/4 kilogram pork belly, cut into serving pieces
- 1/3 cup pineapple juice
- 1/4 cup pineapple chunks
- 1/4 medium onion, minced
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 bay leaf
- 1/4 teaspoon pepper
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar
- Salt, to taste
Steps:
1. Prepare the pork belly and cut it into serving pieces. Place the pork belly in a large bowl and add the pineapple juice and soy sauce. Mix well and marinate for at least 1 hour.
2. After marinating, separate the meat from the marinade. Reserve the marinade.
3. Sear the pork pieces over high heat until the oil has rendered. Flip to sear the other side. Transfer the seared pork to a container.
4. Sauté the onions and garlic for a few minutes. Add the seared pork belly and sauté.
5. Add the reserved marinade, black pepper, brown sugar, and bay leaf. Stir until well combined. Cover the pan and simmer over medium-low heat until the pork is tender. Stir occasionally.
6. Check the tenderness of the pork using a fork. Once tender, add the pineapple chunks. Season with salt and stir well. Simmer for a few minutes until the sauce is reduced.
7. Transfer the pork hamonado to a serving plate and serve with hot steamed rice.

Short Description: Pork braised in soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar for a sweet-tangy, savory stew.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 40 minutes
Overall Time: 55 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/4 kilogram pork belly
- 1–2 pieces semi-ripe saba bananas
- 1/4 cup pineapple juice
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons vinegar
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1/2 medium onion
- 1/2 cup water
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- 1 bay leaf
- Oil, for frying
Steps:
1. Heat some oil in a pan and fry the sliced saba bananas until light brown. Flip to cook the other side. Set aside.
2. Using the same pan, raise the heat to high and sear the pork belly slices until crispy and golden brown. Flip to cook the other side and wait for the oil to render from the fat. Transfer the pork to a container and set aside.
3. Reduce the oil from the pan. Add the garlic and onion, then sauté for a few minutes. Add the pork belly back to the pan and sauté.
4. Pour in the pineapple juice. Sprinkle with pepper, then add the soy sauce and vinegar. Do not stir for 2 minutes. Add the water to help cook the pork. Cover the pan and let the pork simmer until tender.
5. Stir occasionally and check if the pork is tender. Add the bay leaf and brown sugar. Cook for a few minutes until the sauce is reduced.
6. Add the fried bananas and gently stir to coat them with the sauce. Turn off the heat.
7. Transfer the pork estofado to a serving plate and serve with hot steamed rice.

Short Description: Pork stewed with potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers in a tomato sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/4 cup oil
- 1 medium potato, peeled and cubed
- 1 medium carrot, peeled and cubed
- 1/4 green bell pepper, cut into cubes
- 1/4 red bell pepper, cut into cubes
- 1/2 onion, peeled and chopped
- 1 clove garlic, peeled and minced
- 1 pound pork belly or pork butt, cut into 2-inch cubes
- 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce
- 1/2 cup tomato sauce
- 3/4 cup water
- 1/2 tablespoon tomato paste
- Salt and pepper, to taste
Steps:
1. In a wide pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add potatoes and carrots and cook until lightly browned. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels.
2. Remove the oil from the pan except for about 2 tablespoons. Add bell peppers and cook for about 30 seconds. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towels.
3. Add onions and garlic and cook until softened.
4. Add pork and cook until lightly browned.
5. Add fish sauce and cook for about 1 to 2 minutes.
6. Add tomato sauce and water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover, and continue to cook for about 40 to 45 minutes or until the pork is tender.
7. Add potatoes and carrots. Continue to cook until tender and the sauce is thickened and reduced.
8. Add bell peppers and cook for about 1 to 2 minutes or until tender yet crisp.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

Short Description: Sweet-savory marinated pork skewers grilled until caramelized and smoky.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 5 minutes
Cooking Time: 10 minutes
Marinating Time: 3 hours
Overall Time: 3 hours 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 6–8 thin slices pork shoulder
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons banana ketchup
- 1 tablespoon + 2 teaspoons calamansi juice
- 1 tablespoon + 2 teaspoons brown sugar
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/3 teaspoon ground black pepper
- 1 teaspoon cooking oil
- Bamboo skewers
Steps:
1. Arrange the pork slices in a bowl.
2. Add the soy sauce, banana ketchup, calamansi juice, brown sugar, garlic, and black pepper. Mix well.
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. For better flavor, marinate overnight.
4. Thread the marinated pork onto bamboo skewers.
5. Heat the grill and cook the pork for about 3–5 minutes per side, turning and basting until completely cooked.
6. Serve with rice and spicy vinegar.

Short Description: Crispy deep-fried Ilocano pork belly with crackling skin and tender, juicy meat.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 50 minutes
Overall Time: 3 hours 10 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab pork belly
- 1/3 cup pork fat or bacon grease
- 5 cups water
- Cooking oil, enough for deep-frying
- Spicy vinegar, for serving
Steps:
1. Pour the water into a deep cooking pot and bring to a boil.
2. Add the pork fat or bacon grease and pork belly.
3. Cover and boil over medium heat for 2–2 1/2 hours or until the pork is very tender.
4. Remove the pork and let it cool enough to handle. Pat it completely dry with paper towels.
5. Heat enough oil for deep-frying to about 350°F.
6. Deep-fry the pork belly for about 15 minutes or until brown and crispy.
7. Remove and let the excess oil drip off.
8. Cut into serving pieces and serve with spicy vinegar.

Short Description: An Ilocano grilled pork dish dressed with onions, vinegar, and a creamy sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: About 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/3 lb pig ears
- 1/3 lb pork face or maskara
- 2 oz pork liver
- 1/2 red onion
- 2–3 chili peppers
- 1 1/3 tbsp vinegar
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- 2 2/3 cups water
- 1/2 tsp ginger powder
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder (optional)
- 1 bay leaf (optional)
- 1/2 tbsp whole peppercorns (optional)
- Salt and pepper
Steps:
1. Boil pig ears and pork face until tender, about 50–60 minutes.
2. Grill the boiled pork for 4–6 minutes per side.
3. Cook the liver for 5–8 minutes.
4. Chop pork and liver.
5. Mix mayonnaise and vinegar.
6. Add pork, liver, onion, chili, and seasonings.
7. Toss and serve.

Short Description: A savory Ilocano pork and liver stew simmered in soy sauce and vinegar.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: About 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/4 lb pork tenderloin
- 1/4 lb pork liver
- 1/4 lb pork kidney
- 1/2 Knorr Pork Cube
- 1/2 red bell pepper
- 1/4 cup green peas
- 1/2 carrot
- 1–2 bay leaves
- 1/2 onion
- 2–3 cloves garlic
- 3 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 1/2 tbsp white vinegar
- 2/3 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
- Salt and pepper
Steps:
1. Boil kidney with ginger until tender, then slice.
2. Sauté liver briefly and set aside.
3. Sauté garlic and onion.
4. Add kidney and pork.
5. Add soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves, and water; simmer until tender.
6. Add pork cube and vegetables.
7. Add liver and cook a few more minutes.
8. Season and serve.

Short Description: A bitter and savory Ilocano beef innards soup flavored with bile and spices.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: About 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/3 lb ox tripe
- 1/3 lb beef small intestine
- 1/3 lb beef
- 1/3 lb beef heart
- 1–2 tsp beef bile
- 1 thumb ginger
- 1/2 onion
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1 1/3 cups water
- 2 finger chilies
- 1/2 tbsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 lemon or 2–3 calamansi
- 1 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Clean and boil tripe and intestine in salted water.
2. Discard first boiling water and drain.
3. Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger.
4. Add beef, heart, tripe, and intestine.
5. Add water and simmer until tender.
6. Add bile little by little.
7. Add chilies and lemon/calamansi.
8. Season and serve hot.

Short Description: A spicy sautéed pork lung and heart dish with onions, chilies, and a savory sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: About 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- About 3/4 lb pork lungs
- 1/2 Pork Cube
- 2–3 bay leaves
- 1 carrot
- 1–2 thumbs ginger
- 1/2 tbsp annatto powder
- 1–2 Thai chilies
- 1/2 onion
- 2–3 cloves garlic
- 2 1/2 tbsp vinegar
- 1 1/4 cups water
- 1/8 tsp black pepper
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
- Fish sauce, to taste
Steps:
1. Boil pork lungs with water, bay leaves, and ginger for about 1 hour.
2. Drain and dice finely.
3. Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger.
4. Add lungs.
5. Add vinegar and cook about 2 minutes without stirring.
6. Add water, pork cube, and bay leaves; simmer until reduced.
7. Add carrot, chili, and annatto; cook about 3 minutes.
8. Season and serve.

Short Description: A rich, long-simmered beef soup with bone marrow and aromatic herbs.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 3 hours 40 minutes
Overall Time: About 4 hours
Ingredients:
- About 200 g bull testicles
- About 50 g beef tendon
- 2 stalks lemongrass
- 1/2 stalk spring onion
- About 1/4 packet sibot
- 1 bird's eye chili
- 1/2 thumb ginger
- 1/2 white onion
- 2–3 cloves garlic
- 1 cup beef stock
- 1 cup water
- 1/2 cup beef broth
- Fish sauce and black pepper
- 1 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Boil bull testicles and tendon until tender, about 3 1/2 hours.
2. Remove and slice.
3. Sauté garlic, onion, ginger, and lemongrass.
4. Add meat and chili.
5. Add stock, water, and broth.
6. Simmer about 30 minutes.
7. Season.
8. Top with spring onion and serve.

Short Description: Spanish-style roasted suckling pig seasoned with olive oil, salt, and pepper, finished with golden, crispy skin and tender meat.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours
Resting Time: 10 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 20 minutes
Ingredients:
- 900 g suckling pig, skin on
- 2 tbsp olive oil, plus 2 tsp
- Salt, to taste
- Ground black pepper, to taste
- 1 small garlic clove, crushed (optional)
- 2 tbsp butter or pork lard, plus 2 tsp
- 2/3 cup hot water
Steps:
1. Remove the suckling pig from the refrigerator and allow it to lose its chill briefly before cooking. Pat the skin and meat thoroughly dry with paper towels.
2. Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F).
3. Rub the olive oil over the pig and season the meat and skin with salt and ground black pepper.
4. Place the pig skin-side down in a roasting pan. Pour the hot water into the bottom of the pan, keeping the skin above the water.
5. Roast for about 60-75 minutes, basting the meat occasionally with the pan juices. Add more hot water if the pan becomes dry.
6. Carefully turn the pig skin-side up. Prick any visible air bubbles in the skin carefully, then spread the butter or pork lard over the skin. Add the crushed garlic if using.
7. Increase the oven temperature to 200°C (400°F). Roast for another 25-35 minutes, until the skin is golden and crisp and the meat is cooked through.
8. Check the thickest part of the meat with a food thermometer. For this roast, aim for at least 71°C (160°F).
9. Remove the pig from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting into portions.
10. Serve hot while the skin is crisp.

Short Description: Leftover lechon simmered in a tangy vinegar-liver sauce with spices.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Overall Time: About 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- About 1 lb cooked lechon
- 3/4 cup lechon sauce
- 1/2 onion
- 3 cloves garlic
- 1/2 tsp peppercorns
- 2 bay leaves
- 3/8 tsp garlic powder
- 3/8 tsp onion powder
- 3/8 cup vinegar
- 3/8 cup sugar
- 3/4 cup water
- 1 1/2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Sauté garlic and onion in oil.
2. Add lechon.
3. Add vinegar and water.
4. Add bay leaves, peppercorns, and powders.
5. Simmer 15 minutes.
6. Add lechon sauce and sugar.
7. Simmer 5 more minutes.
8. Adjust seasoning and serve.

Short Description: Roasted pork simmered in vinegar, sugar, and spices for a sweet-sour, savory dish.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Overall Time: About 35 minutes
Ingredients:
- About 1/2 kg leftover lechon
- 1/2 cup lechon sauce
- 2 tbsp vinegar
- 1 cup water
- 2–3 cloves garlic
- 1 bay leaf
- 1/2 tsp peppercorns
- 1–2 tbsp brown sugar
- Salt
- 1 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Sauté garlic in oil.
2. Add lechon.
3. Add vinegar and water.
4. Add bay leaf and peppercorns.
5. Bring to a boil before stirring.
6. Add lechon sauce and brown sugar.
7. Simmer 20–30 minutes until thickened.
8. Season and serve.

Short Description: A classic pulutan of fried tofu and boiled pork tossed in soy sauce, vinegar, and onions.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: About 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces pig ears, or 1 small piece pork belly as an alternative
- 2 pieces extra-firm tofu, about 2-inch squares
- 1/2 tbsp whole peppercorns
- 1/2 tbsp salt
- 1/2 small red onion
- 1–2 stalks scallions
- 1–2 Thai chili peppers
- 2 1/2 cups water
- Cooking oil for frying
- 3/4 cup white vinegar
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 3/4 tsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp salt
- Pinch of ground black pepper
Steps:
1. Clean the pork thoroughly.
2. Boil pork with salt and peppercorns until tender, about 30–60 minutes.
3. Cool and slice pork into bite-sized pieces.
4. Deep-fry tofu until golden and crisp.
5. Cut tofu into cubes.
6. Mix vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper.
7. Add onion, scallions, and chili.
8. Arrange pork and tofu and pour sauce over them.
9. Serve immediately.

Short Description: Garlicky, sweet-savory pork sausages from Lucban, seasoned with vinegar and spices.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 40 minutes
Curing Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: About 8 hours 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 cup ground pork with some fat
- 5 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp vinegar
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1 tsp paprika
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tbsp brown sugar
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
- 1/4 cup water
Steps:
1. Mix pork, garlic, vinegar, oregano, paprika, pepper, salt and brown sugar until well combined.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight to let the flavors develop.
3. Shape the mixture into 4 to 6 small sausage links (or stuff into hog casing if available).
4. Place in a pan with water and simmer on low heat until the water evaporates.
5. Add oil and fry until browned on all sides.
6. Serve with garlic rice, egg and spiced vinegar.

Short Description: Garlicky, salty Vigan-style sausages with a tangy bite, usually served with rice.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 40 minutes
Curing Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: About 8 hours 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 cup ground pork with some fat
- 8 cloves garlic, minced
- 3 tbsp sukang Iloko (cane vinegar)
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 tsp brown sugar
- 1/4 tsp paprika
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
- 1/4 cup water
Steps:
1. Combine pork, garlic, vinegar, salt, pepper, brown sugar and paprika. Mix thoroughly.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
3. Shape into 6 to 8 small, thin links (or stuff into hog casing if available).
4. Simmer in a pan with water until the water evaporates.
5. Add oil and fry on low heat until golden brown.
6. Serve with garlic rice and spiced vinegar.

Short Description: Skinless sausage patties of seasoned pork that fry up quickly for breakfast.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 30 minutes
Curing Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: 8 hours 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 cup ground pork with some fat
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp vinegar
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1/2 tsp paprika
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
- 1/4 cup water
Steps:
1. Mix pork with garlic, brown sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper and paprika.
2. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.
3. Shape into 6 to 8 small sausages by hand (no casing).
4. Simmer in a pan with water until the water has evaporated.
5. Add oil and fry until browned and slightly caramelized.
6. Serve with garlic rice and fried egg.

Short Description: Sweet, savory pork sausages cured in sugar and spices for a caramelized finish.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 30 minutes
Curing Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: About 8 hours 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 cup ground pork with some fat
- 1/4 cup pineapple juice
- 3 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
- 1/4 cup water
Steps:
1. Mix pork with pineapple juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic, salt and pepper.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
3. Shape into 6 to 8 small sausages.
4. Simmer in a pan with water until the liquid is absorbed.
5. Add oil and fry on low heat until caramelized and browned.
6. Serve with garlic rice and egg.

Short Description: Crispy fried pork skin cracklings seasoned with salt and served with vinegar.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Drying Time: 6 hours
Overall Time: 7 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab pork skin
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1 tsp whole peppercorns
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 4 cups water
- 2 cups cooking oil for deep frying
- 3 tbsp spiced vinegar for dipping
Steps:
1. Boil the pork skin in water with salt, peppercorns and bay leaves for 45 minutes until tender.
2. Drain and scrape off any excess fat from the underside.
3. Cut into bite-sized pieces and dry in a 100 C oven for about 6 hours until hard and brittle.
4. Heat oil to medium-hot and fry a few pieces at a time; they will puff up in seconds.
5. Drain on paper towels and season with a little salt.
6. Serve with spiced vinegar.

Short Description: Crispy deep-fried pork mesentery with a crunchy, bubbly texture, served with a vinegar dip.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 small portion pork ruffle fat (bulaklak), cleaned
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1 tsp whole peppercorns
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 4 cups water
- 2 cups cooking oil for deep frying
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 1 piece siling labuyo, chopped
Steps:
1. Rinse the ruffle fat well with salt and vinegar, then rinse again.
2. Boil in water with salt, peppercorns and bay leaves for 45 minutes until tender.
3. Drain, pat very dry, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Air-dry for at least 30 minutes.
4. Deep fry in hot oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden and crispy. Cover to avoid splatter.
5. Drain on paper towels.
6. Mix vinegar, garlic, onion and chili for the dip and serve alongside.

Short Description: Crispy deep-fried pork intestines, crunchy and savory, best with spicy vinegar.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 small portion pork intestines, cleaned
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1 tsp whole peppercorns
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 4 cups water
- 2 cups cooking oil for deep frying
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 piece siling labuyo, chopped
Steps:
1. Clean the intestines thoroughly with salt and vinegar and rinse several times.
2. Boil with salt, peppercorns and bay leaves for 1 hr until tender.
3. Drain well, cut into 2-inch pieces, and dry completely.
4. Deep fry in hot oil until crisp and golden, about 8 minutes. Cover to avoid splatter.
5. Drain on paper towels.
6. Combine vinegar, garlic and chili as the dip.

Short Description: Clear Filipino pork soup with ribs, corn, potatoes, saba bananas, cabbage, and pechay.
Flavor profiles: Clean, savory, gently sweet from corn and saba
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 75 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 400 g pork spare ribs or pork shoulder with bone
- 1 small onion, quartered
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 1 small corn cob, cut into 2-3 pieces
- 1 medium potato, quartered
- 1 small saba banana, halved (optional)
- 1 cup cabbage, cut into wedges
- 1 small bunch pechay
- 1 tbsp fish sauce, plus more to taste
- 5 cups water, plus more if needed
Steps:
1. Put the pork in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse the pork and pot to remove excess scum.
2. Return the pork to the pot with 5 cups fresh water, onion, and peppercorns. Bring to a boil, skim the surface, then simmer gently for 45-60 minutes until the pork is tender. Add hot water as needed.
3. Add corn and potato and cook for 10-12 minutes. Add saba if using and simmer until tender.
4. Add cabbage and cook for 3-4 minutes.
5. Season with fish sauce. Add pechay and simmer for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
6. Taste the clear broth and adjust fish sauce. Serve hot.

Short Description: A rich Filipino stew of pork, plantains, and chickpeas in a savory tomato sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 3-4 pieces pork belly, cubed
- 1 piece chorizo de Bilbao, sliced
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 pieces saba bananas, sliced
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1/4 cup canned chickpeas (garbanzos)
- 1/4 head cabbage, wedged
- 1 bunch pechay
- 1/2 cup green beans (baguio beans)
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 3 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add pork and cook until lightly browned.
2. Add chorizo and tomato sauce and cook for 3 minutes.
3. Pour in water and simmer for 45 minutes until the pork is tender.
4. Add saba, potato and chickpeas. Cook for 10 minutes.
5. Add green beans and cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
6. Season with fish sauce, add pechay, and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot.

Short Description: A hearty pork stew in tomato sauce with potatoes, carrots, bell peppers, and cheese.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 3-4 pieces pork kasim, cubed
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp liver spread
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 piece siling labuyo (optional)
- 2 tbsp grated cheese
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add pork and brown on all sides.
2. Pour in tomato sauce and water. Simmer covered for 45 minutes until the pork is tender.
3. Stir in liver spread and fish sauce.
4. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
5. Add bell pepper, chili and cheese. Cook for 3 more minutes and serve.

Short Description: Pork braised in a tangy tomato-soy sauce until tender, with potatoes and carrots.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 45 minutes
Marinating Time: 30 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 3-4 pieces pork kasim, in large chunks
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp calamansi juice
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1 piece carrot, sliced
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Marinate pork in soy sauce and calamansi juice for 30 minutes.
2. Brown the pork in oil, then remove and set aside.
3. In the same pan, saute garlic and onion.
4. Return the pork and add tomato sauce, bay leaves, the marinade and water.
5. Simmer covered for 1 hr until tender.
6. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
7. Add bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Serve hot.

Short Description: Crispy pork tossed in a bright sweet and sour sauce with bell peppers and pineapple.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Overall Time: 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 3-4 pieces pork loin, cubed
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 piece egg, beaten
- 1/3 cup cornstarch
- 1/2 cup pineapple chunks
- 1/2 piece red bell pepper, cubed
- 1/2 piece green bell pepper, cubed
- 1 small carrot, sliced
- 2 tbsp vinegar
- 3 tbsp sugar
- 3 tbsp tomato ketchup
- 1/4 cup pineapple juice
- 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
- 1 cup cooking oil
Steps:
1. Season pork with salt and pepper. Dip in egg, then coat in cornstarch.
2. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crisp. Drain.
3. In another pan, simmer ketchup, vinegar, sugar and pineapple juice for 2 minutes.
4. Add carrot and bell peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
5. Add pineapple chunks and the cornstarch mixture; stir until thickened.
6. Toss in the fried pork to coat. Serve right away.

Short Description: Tender pork slices simmered in a sweet-savory sauce of soy, sugar, and garlic.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Marinating Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab pork kasim, cut into chunks
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 3 tbsp calamansi juice
- 1/2 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Marinate pork in soy sauce and calamansi juice for 1 hr.
2. Brown the pork in oil, then add garlic and onion.
3. Add the marinade, tomato sauce, bay leaves, brown sugar and water.
4. Simmer covered for 1 hr until the pork is tender.
5. Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook until the sauce is glossy and thick.
6. Slice or serve in chunks with rice.

Short Description: Pork marinated in calamansi, lemongrass, and vinegar, then grilled for a smoky, tangy flavor.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 40 minutes
Marinating Time: 4 hours
Overall Time: 4 hours 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab pork belly, sliced into thick strips
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 3 tbsp calamansi juice
- 2 stalks lemongrass, crushed
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, minced
- 5 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 3 tbsp annatto oil (for basting)
Steps:
1. Combine vinegar, calamansi juice, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, sugar, salt and pepper.
2. Marinate the pork for at least 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.
3. Grill over medium coals, basting with annatto oil, for 6 to 8 minutes per side.
4. Rest for 5 minutes, then serve with rice and sawsawan.

Short Description: A whole roasted suckling pig with crisp, golden skin and delicate, tender meat.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Drying Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: About 10 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab young pork belly with ribs, skin-on
- 2 stalks lemongrass, crushed
- 1 head garlic, crushed
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 2 pieces star anise
- 1 tbsp rock salt
- 1 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Rub the meat side with salt, pepper and soy sauce, keeping the skin dry.
2. Place lemongrass, garlic, onion, bay leaves and star anise on the meat side and roll or fold tightly. Tie with twine.
3. Air-dry in the refrigerator, uncovered, overnight.
4. Roast at 150 C for 1 hr 30 mins, basting the meat side with oil.
5. Increase heat to 230 C and roast 20 to 30 minutes until the skin is crisp and bubbly.
6. Rest for 10 minutes, chop and serve with liver sauce.

Short Description: A traditional Cordillera chicken soup flavored with ginger and smoky tastes.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 5 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/2 native chicken, cut up (dressed)
- 2 small pieces etag (salted cured pork), or smoked pork
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 1 piece sayote, wedged
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 4 cups water
Steps:
1. Lightly pound the dressed chicken pieces with the back of a knife (traditional bruising to tenderize).
2. Singe the chicken skin over an open flame until slightly charred and smoky, then scrape and rinse.
3. Bring water to a boil with the etag, ginger and onion.
4. Add chicken and simmer for 40 minutes.
5. Add sayote and cook for 10 minutes.
6. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

Short Description: A bitter and savory Ilocano stew of beef innards, ginger, and spices.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 3-4 pieces beef brisket, cubed
- 1 small portion beef tripe, cleaned and sliced
- 2 tbsp beef bile (apdo), or to taste
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, crushed
- 2 pieces siling labuyo
- 1 piece siling haba
- 1 tsp salt
- 5 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Boil the brisket and tripe in water for 1 hr 15 mins until tender.
2. Saute garlic, onion and ginger in oil, then add the boiled meat with 3 cups of its broth.
3. Add siling labuyo and siling haba and simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Season with salt.
5. Stir in bile a little at a time to taste.
6. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot.

Short Description: Pork cooked in vinegar, soy sauce, and spices until tender in a tangy, savory sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 5 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab pork belly, cubed
- 1/3 cup vinegar
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 head garlic, crushed
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 2 pieces saba bananas, sliced
- 1 piece siling haba
- 1 cup water
Steps:
1. Combine pork, vinegar, garlic, peppercorns and bay leaves in a pot. Boil without stirring for 3 minutes.
2. Add soy sauce, brown sugar and water.
3. Simmer covered for 45 minutes until the pork is tender.
4. Add saba and siling haba and cook for 10 minutes.
5. Cook uncovered until the sauce thickens slightly. Serve hot.

Short Description: Ground beef sautéed with potatoes, tomatoes, and carrots in a savory-sweet sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Overall Time: 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 cup ground beef
- 1 piece potato, diced
- 1 piece carrot, diced
- 1/4 cup raisins
- 1/4 cup green peas
- 1/2 cup tomato sauce
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1/2 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil until soft.
2. Add ground beef and cook until browned.
3. Add soy sauce, fish sauce, tomato sauce and water. Simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes until tender.
5. Add raisins and green peas and cook for 3 minutes.
6. Season with pepper and serve with rice.

Short Description: A rich beef stew in a tomato-liver sauce with potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces beef chuck cubes
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp liver spread
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1/4 cup green olives
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 pieces siling labuyo
- 2 tbsp grated cheese
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add beef and brown on all sides.
2. Pour in tomato sauce and water. Simmer covered for 1 hr 30 mins until the beef is tender.
3. Stir in liver spread and fish sauce.
4. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
5. Add bell pepper, olives, chili and cheese. Cook for 3 more minutes and serve.

Short Description: A rich, spicy goat stew simmered in tomato sauce with potatoes and bell peppers.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Marinating Time: 30 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces goat meat, cubed
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp liver spread
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 1 head garlic, minced
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 3 pieces siling labuyo
- 2 tbsp vinegar
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Marinate goat meat in vinegar and ginger for 30 minutes. Drain.
2. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add goat meat and brown.
3. Add tomato sauce and water. Simmer covered for 1 hr 45 mins until tender.
4. Stir in liver spread and fish sauce.
5. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
6. Add bell pepper and chili, cook for 3 minutes, and serve.

Short Description: Beef braised in a tangy tomato-soy sauce until fork-tender.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Marinating Time: 30 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces beef kasim, in large chunks
- 1 small strip pork fat (for larding)
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp calamansi juice
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1 piece carrot, sliced
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Insert thin strips of pork fat into the beef chunks and marinate in soy sauce and calamansi juice for 30 minutes.
2. Brown the beef in oil and set aside.
3. Saute garlic and onion, then return the beef.
4. Add tomato sauce, bay leaves, marinade and water.
5. Simmer covered for 1 hr 30 mins until tender.
6. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes, then bell pepper for 3 minutes. Serve.

Short Description: Beef stewed with potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers in a mild tomato sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces beef chuck cubes
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1/4 cup green peas
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add beef and brown.
2. Add tomato sauce, bay leaves and water. Simmer covered for 1 hr 15 mins until tender.
3. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add bell pepper and green peas and cook for 3 minutes.
5. Season with fish sauce and pepper. Serve hot.

Short Description: Tender beef braised in a sweet-savory soy broth, served over garlic rice.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab beef brisket, cubed
- 1/3 cup soy sauce
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 3 pieces star anise
- 1 head garlic, minced
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 2 stalks scallions, chopped
- 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
- 3 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
- 2 tbsp fried garlic
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and ginger in oil. Add beef and brown.
2. Add soy sauce, brown sugar, star anise and water.
3. Simmer covered for 2 hrs until the beef is very tender. Reserve 1 cup of the broth.
4. Stir in the cornstarch mixture to thicken the sauce.
5. Serve over garlic rice topped with fried garlic and scallions, with the reserved broth on the side.

Short Description: A comforting noodle soup of beef broth, egg noodles, and tender beef.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 piece beef shank, with bone
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 2 nests egg noodles
- 2 pieces boiled eggs
- 2 stalks scallions, chopped
- 2 tbsp fried garlic
- 5 cups water
Steps:
1. Boil beef shank in water with onion, ginger and peppercorns for 1 hr 30 mins until tender.
2. Remove the beef, shred or slice, and strain the broth.
3. Season the broth with soy sauce and fish sauce.
4. Cook the egg noodles in hot water for 3 minutes. Drain.
5. Divide noodles into 2 bowls. Top with beef, halved eggs, scallions and fried garlic.
6. Ladle hot broth over and serve.

Short Description: Clear beef soup built from slowly simmered beef shank, corn, potatoes, saba bananas, cabbage, and pechay.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours
Overall Time: 2 hours 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 500 g beef shank or bone-in beef stew pieces
- 1 small onion, quartered
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 1 small corn cob, cut into 2-3 pieces
- 1 medium potato, quartered
- 1 small saba banana, halved (optional)
- 1 cup cabbage, cut into wedges
- 1 small bunch pechay
- 1 tbsp fish sauce, plus more to taste
- 6 cups water, plus more if needed
Steps:
1. Place beef in a pot, cover with water, and boil for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse the meat and pot to remove excess scum.
2. Return the beef to the pot with 6 cups fresh water, onion, and peppercorns. Bring to a boil, skim the surface, then simmer gently for 1 1/2-2 hours until the beef is fork-tender; top up with hot water if needed.
3. Add corn and potato and simmer for about 12 minutes. Add saba if using and cook until tender.
4. Add cabbage and cook for 3-4 minutes. Season with fish sauce.
5. Add pechay and simmer for 1-2 minutes, just until wilted.
6. Taste and adjust the broth seasoning. Serve hot while the beef is tender and the broth remains clear.

Short Description: A rich, clear beef shank soup with bone marrow, corn, and cabbage.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 40 minutes
Overall Time: 3 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 large piece beef shank with bone marrow
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 1 piece corn on the cob, cut into 3
- 1/4 head cabbage, wedged
- 1 bunch pechay
- 1/2 cup string beans, cut
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 6 cups water
Steps:
1. Boil beef shank in water for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse.
2. Return to the pot with fresh water, onion and peppercorns. Simmer on low for 2 hrs 30 mins until very tender.
3. Add corn and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add string beans and cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
5. Season with fish sauce, add pechay, and serve hot with the marrow bone.

Short Description: Thin sweet-salty beef strips marinated overnight and pan-fried until browned and sticky.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 10 minutes
Marinating Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: About 8 hours 20 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab beef sirloin, sliced thin
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 3 tbsp calamansi juice
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 5 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Combine soy sauce, calamansi juice, brown sugar, garlic and pepper.
2. Add the beef, mix well, and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
3. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
4. Fry the beef in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side until browned and slightly caramelized.
5. Serve with garlic rice and a fried egg.

Short Description: Dried, cured venison-style meat marinated in a sweet, salty cure and fried until crisp.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 20 minutes
Curing Time: 8 hours
Drying Time: 4 hours
Overall Time: About 12 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab venison (deer meat), sliced thin
- 1 tbsp rock salt
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 5 cloves garlic, crushed
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 tbsp vinegar
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Rub the sliced venison with salt, sugar, garlic, pepper and vinegar.
2. Cure in the refrigerator overnight.
3. Sun-dry or air-dry for about 4 hours until the surface is dry and firm.
4. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
5. Fry the venison for 2 to 3 minutes per side until browned.
6. Serve with garlic rice and spiced vinegar.

Short Description: Quick-seared beef cubes tossed with garlic butter, Worcestershire, soy sauce, and spring onion.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Marinating Time: 15 minutes
Overall Time: 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 250 g beef tenderloin or sirloin, cut into bite-sized cubes
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped
- 1 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp cooking oil
- 1 spring onion, sliced
- Salt, only if needed
Steps:
1. Pat the beef dry, then toss with soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Marinate for 15 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a wide pan over high heat. Sear the beef in a single layer for about 1-2 minutes per side, working in batches if needed. Remove while it is still tender.
3. Reduce the heat to medium-low and add butter and garlic. Cook until the garlic is fragrant and just turning golden; do not let it burn.
4. Return the beef and any resting juices. Toss for 30-60 seconds to coat with garlic butter without overcooking the beef.
5. Add spring onion and taste before adding salt. Serve immediately with garlic rice.

Short Description: Tender beef strips and broccoli stir-fried in a glossy oyster-soy sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 5 minutes
Cooking Time: 5 minutes
Marinating Time: 15 minutes
Overall Time: 25 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab beef sirloin, sliced into thin strips
- 1 small head broccoli, cut into florets
- 2 tbsp oyster sauce
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1 tsp cornstarch (for beef)
- 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup water
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, minced
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Marinate beef in soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain.
3. Heat oil and saute garlic and ginger. Add beef and stir-fry until browned.
4. Add oyster sauce, sugar and the cornstarch mixture; stir until thick.
5. Add broccoli and toss for 1 minute.
6. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve.

Short Description: A hearty beef stew with plantains, cabbage, and chickpeas in a savory tomato broth.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours
Overall Time: 2 hours 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 piece beef shank, cut into chunks
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 pieces saba bananas, sliced
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1/4 cup canned chickpeas (garbanzos)
- 1/4 head cabbage, wedged
- 1 bunch pechay
- 1/2 cup green beans (baguio beans)
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 4 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add beef and brown.
2. Add tomato sauce and water. Simmer covered for 1 hr 30 mins until tender.
3. Add saba, potato and chickpeas and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add green beans and cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
5. Season with fish sauce, add pechay and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot.

Short Description: Beef tongue braised in soy sauce, vinegar, and tomato until fork-tender.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small piece ox tongue
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 3 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 head garlic, crushed
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 1 piece carrot, sliced
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 2 pieces saba bananas, sliced
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Boil the ox tongue in water for 1 hr until tender. Peel off the skin and slice into thick pieces.
2. Saute garlic in oil. Add the tongue slices and brown lightly.
3. Add soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, bay leaves, peppercorns and water.
4. Simmer for 30 minutes.
5. Add carrot, potato and saba and cook for 15 minutes until tender and the sauce thickens. Serve hot.

Short Description: A creamy beef pot pie-style stew with mushrooms, peas, and a savory, rich sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces beef cubes
- 1 cup evaporated milk
- 1/2 cup button mushrooms, sliced
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1/4 cup green peas
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 1 sheet puff pastry
- 1 piece egg, beaten (for glaze)
Steps:
1. Boil beef in water with a pinch of salt for 1 hr 15 mins until tender. Reserve 1 cup of broth.
2. Saute garlic and onion in butter. Add beef, mushrooms, carrot and potato and cook for 5 minutes.
3. Stir in flour, then pour in the reserved broth, evaporated milk and soy sauce. Simmer until thick.
4. Add green peas and cook for 2 minutes. Transfer to an oven-safe dish.
5. Cover with puff pastry, trim, and brush with beaten egg.
6. Bake at 200 C for 20 minutes until golden. Serve hot.

Short Description: A rich Spanish-Filipino stew of ox tripe and chickpeas in a tomato sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 40 minutes
Overall Time: 3 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 small portion ox tripe, cleaned and cubed
- 1 small piece ox feet (cow's feet), cut up
- 1 piece chorizo de Bilbao, sliced
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 1/4 cup canned chickpeas (garbanzos)
- 1/4 cup green olives
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp paprika
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 4 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Boil the tripe and ox feet in water for 2 hrs until very tender. Reserve about 2 cups of broth.
2. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add chorizo and cook for 2 minutes.
3. Add tomato sauce, paprika, tripe, ox feet and the reserved broth.
4. Simmer for 30 minutes.
5. Add chickpeas, olives and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
6. Season with fish sauce and serve hot.

Short Description: A hearty Spanish-style boiled dinner of meats, chickpeas, and vegetables.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 piece beef shank, cut up
- 2 pieces pork belly, cubed
- 1 piece chorizo de Bilbao, sliced
- 1/4 cup canned chickpeas (garbanzos)
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1 piece carrot, sliced
- 2 pieces saba bananas, halved
- 1/4 head cabbage, wedged
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 3 cloves garlic, crushed
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 5 cups water
Steps:
1. Boil beef and pork belly in water with onion and garlic for 1 hr 30 mins until tender.
2. Add chorizo, chickpeas, potato, carrot and saba. Cook for 12 minutes.
3. Add cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
4. Season with fish sauce.
5. Serve the meats and vegetables in the broth.

Short Description: Beef braised in a sweet-savory soy and vinegar sauce until tender.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces beef chuck cubes
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 3 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 head garlic, crushed
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 1 piece carrot, sliced
- 2 pieces saba bananas, sliced
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Brown the beef in oil with garlic.
2. Add soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, bay leaves, peppercorns and water.
3. Simmer covered for 1 hr 15 mins until the beef is tender.
4. Add carrot, potato and saba and cook for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens.
5. Serve hot.

Short Description: Beef tongue in a creamy mushroom sauce, tender and rich.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small piece ox tongue
- 1 cup button mushrooms, sliced
- 1 cup evaporated milk
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 4 cups water
- 1 cup beef broth from boiling
Steps:
1. Boil the ox tongue in water with a pinch of salt for 1 hr 30 mins until tender. Peel off the skin, slice, and reserve the broth.
2. Saute garlic and onion in butter. Add mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
3. Stir in flour, then add the beef broth and evaporated milk. Simmer until the sauce thickens.
4. Add the tongue slices and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Short Description: A Visayan beef shank soup soured with batwan or tamarind and flavored with ginger.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 piece beef shank, with bone marrow
- 1 cup unripe jackfruit (langka), sliced
- 4-5 pieces batwan (or kamias / tamarind as substitute)
- 2 stalks lemongrass, crushed
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 1 piece tomato, quartered
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 1 tsp salt
- 6 cups water
Steps:
1. Boil beef shank in water for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse.
2. Return the beef to the pot with fresh water, onion, ginger, lemongrass and peppercorns. Simmer for 1 hr 45 mins until tender.
3. Add jackfruit and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add batwan (or kamias / tamarind) and tomato and cook for 5 more minutes until the broth turns sour.
5. Season with salt and serve hot.

Short Description: A slow-cooked Cebuano beef stew with a rich, sticky, savory broth.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 3 hours 40 minutes
Overall Time: 4 hours
Ingredients:
- 1 small piece beef skin, cut up
- 1 small piece ox feet (cow's feet), cut up
- 2 stalks lemongrass, crushed
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 3 pieces star anise
- 1 tbsp fermented black beans (tausi)
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp annatto oil
- 1 head garlic, crushed
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 1/2 tsp whole peppercorns
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 5 cups water
Steps:
1. Boil the beef skin and ox feet in water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse.
2. Saute garlic, onion and ginger in annatto oil. Add the meat.
3. Add water, lemongrass, star anise, bay leaves, peppercorns and tausi.
4. Simmer on low heat for 3 hrs 15 mins until very tender and gelatinous.
5. Add soy sauce and brown sugar and simmer until the sauce thickens and turns glossy. Serve with rice.

Short Description: Beef sautéed with bitter melon in a savory oyster-soy sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Overall Time: 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1 small slab beef sirloin, sliced into thin strips
- 1 medium ampalaya (bitter melon), sliced
- 1 tsp salt (for soaking ampalaya)
- 2 tbsp oyster sauce
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 piece tomato, sliced
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 1/4 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Toss ampalaya with salt, let it sit for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the liquid and rinse.
2. Marinate beef in soy sauce and cornstarch for 10 minutes.
3. Saute garlic, onion and tomato in oil. Add beef and cook until browned.
4. Add oyster sauce and water and simmer for 3 minutes.
5. Add ampalaya and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender. Serve hot.

Short Description: A tangy and spicy goat kilaw with vinegar, ginger, and onions.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 6-8 pieces goat meat, cubed
- 1/2 cup vinegar
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium red onion, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, crushed
- 3 pieces siling labuyo
- 2 tbsp calamansi juice
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 tsp salt
- 4 cups water
Steps:
1. Boil goat meat in water with ginger, garlic and salt for 1 hr 15 mins until tender. Drain.
2. Lightly grill or pan-sear the goat for a smoky edge (optional).
3. In a bowl, combine vinegar, calamansi juice, onion, chili and pepper.
4. Add the goat meat and toss well.
5. Let it rest for 10 minutes and serve as pulutan.

Short Description: A bitter and savory goat innards soup flavored with ginger and spices.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 20 minutes
Cooking Time: 2 hours 10 minutes
Overall Time: 2 hours 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 4-5 pieces goat meat, cubed
- 1 small portion goat innards (tripe and intestines), cleaned and sliced
- 2 tbsp goat bile (apdo), or to taste
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, crushed
- 2 pieces siling labuyo
- 1 piece siling haba
- 1 tsp salt
- 5 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Boil goat meat and innards in water for 1 hr 30 mins until tender. Discard the first water if the smell is strong.
2. Saute garlic, onion and ginger in oil. Add the meat and innards with 3 cups of broth.
3. Add chili and simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Season with salt.
5. Stir in the bile a little at a time to taste.
6. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot.

Short Description: A comforting chicken stew with potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers in tomato sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 35 minutes
Overall Time: 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1/4 cup green peas
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add chicken and brown lightly.
2. Add tomato sauce, bay leaves and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
3. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add bell pepper and green peas and cook for 3 minutes.
5. Season with fish sauce and pepper. Serve hot.

Short Description: A rich chicken stew in tomato sauce with potatoes, bell peppers, and cheese.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 40 minutes
Overall Time: 55 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp liver spread
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1/4 cup green olives
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 pieces siling labuyo
- 2 tbsp grated cheese
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add chicken and brown.
2. Add tomato sauce and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
3. Stir in liver spread and fish sauce.
4. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
5. Add bell pepper, olives, chili and cheese and cook for 3 minutes. Serve hot.

Short Description: A creamy chicken and vegetable stew with mushrooms and a rich, savory sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 small piece chorizo de Bilbao, sliced
- 1/2 cup button mushrooms, sliced
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1/4 cup green peas
- 1 cup evaporated milk
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 cup water
- 1 sheet puff pastry
- 1 piece egg, beaten (for glaze)
Steps:
1. Boil chicken in water for 20 minutes. Remove, debone and shred; reserve the broth.
2. Saute garlic and onion in butter. Add chorizo, mushrooms, carrot and potato for 5 minutes.
3. Stir in flour, then add 1 cup of broth, evaporated milk and soy sauce. Simmer until thick.
4. Add chicken and green peas. Transfer to an oven-safe dish.
5. Cover with puff pastry, trim the edges, and brush with beaten egg.
6. Bake at 200 C for 20 minutes until golden.

Short Description: A savory chicken stew with plantains, cabbage, and chickpeas in tomato broth.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 45 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 small piece chorizo de Bilbao, sliced
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 pieces saba bananas, sliced
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1/4 cup canned chickpeas (garbanzos)
- 1/4 head cabbage, wedged
- 1 bunch pechay
- 1/2 cup green beans (baguio beans)
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 3 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add chicken and chorizo and brown lightly.
2. Add tomato sauce and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
3. Add saba, potato and chickpeas and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add green beans and cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
5. Season with fish sauce, add pechay and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot.

Short Description: Chicken braised in a tangy tomato-soy sauce with potatoes and carrots.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 45 minutes
Marinating Time: 30 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp calamansi juice
- 1 piece potato, quartered
- 1 piece carrot, sliced
- 1 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 2 pieces bay leaves
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce and calamansi juice for 30 minutes.
2. Brown the chicken in oil, then add garlic and onion.
3. Add tomato sauce, bay leaves, marinade and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
4. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
5. Add bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Serve hot.

Short Description: Chicken marinated in calamansi, lemongrass, and vinegar, then grilled with annatto oil.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Marinating Time: 4 hours
Overall Time: 4 hours 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters)
- 1/4 cup coconut vinegar
- 3 tbsp calamansi juice
- 2 stalks lemongrass, crushed
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, minced
- 5 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp ground black pepper
- 3 tbsp annatto oil (for basting)
- 1 tbsp butter
Steps:
1. Combine vinegar, calamansi juice, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, sugar, salt and pepper.
2. Marinate the chicken for at least 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.
3. Mix annatto oil and butter for basting.
4. Grill over medium coals for 15 to 20 minutes per side, basting often, until cooked through and lightly charred.
5. Serve with rice, calamansi and a soy-vinegar dip.

Short Description: Chicken simmered in creamy coconut milk with pineapple, a sweet-savory dish.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 35 minutes
Overall Time: 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1/2 cup pineapple chunks
- 1/2 cup pineapple juice
- 1/2 cup evaporated milk
- 1 piece potato, cubed
- 1 piece carrot, cubed
- 1/2 piece red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1/2 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic and onion in oil. Add chicken and brown lightly.
2. Add fish sauce, pineapple juice and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
3. Add potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Pour in evaporated milk and add pineapple chunks. Simmer for 5 minutes.
5. Add bell pepper, season with pepper and serve.

Short Description: Chicken cooked in rich coconut milk with ginger and chilies for a mildly spicy sauce.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 35 minutes
Overall Time: 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 cup coconut milk
- 1/2 cup coconut cream
- 1 piece sayote, wedged
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 pieces siling haba
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1 handful malunggay or spinach leaves
- 1/2 cup water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic, onion and ginger in oil. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
2. Add fish sauce, coconut milk and water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
3. Add sayote and siling haba and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Stir in coconut cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
5. Add malunggay leaves and serve hot.

Short Description: A comforting chicken soup flavored with young coconut water and ginger.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 45 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 2 cups fresh coconut water (buko juice)
- 1/2 cup young coconut meat (buko), strips
- 2 stalks lemongrass, crushed
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 handful malunggay or pepper leaves
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 2 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic, onion and ginger in oil. Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
2. Pour in coconut water and water. Add lemongrass.
3. Simmer covered for 30 minutes until the chicken is tender.
4. Add buko strips and fish sauce and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add malunggay leaves and serve hot.

Short Description: A festive deboned chicken stuffed with ground pork, vegetables, and egg.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces boneless chicken thighs
- 1/2 cup ground pork
- 1 small carrot, minced
- 2 tbsp raisins
- 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish
- 1 piece egg, beaten
- 1 piece hard-boiled egg, quartered
- 2 tbsp bread crumbs
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Pound the chicken thighs flat and season with soy sauce and pepper.
2. Mix ground pork, carrot, raisins, relish, beaten egg, bread crumbs, garlic and salt to make the stuffing.
3. Spoon the stuffing onto each thigh and place a piece of boiled egg in the center.
4. Roll tightly and tie with kitchen twine.
5. Brown the rolls in oil on all sides, then bake at 180 C for 35 to 40 minutes until cooked through.
6. Rest for 10 minutes, slice and serve with gravy or ketchup.

Short Description: A festive deboned chicken stuffed with ground pork and ham, then poached or baked.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 30 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces boneless chicken thighs
- 1/2 cup ground pork
- 2 slices ham, chopped
- 1 piece hard-boiled egg, chopped
- 2 tbsp cheese, grated
- 2 tbsp raisins
- 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish
- 1 piece raw egg, beaten
- 2 tbsp bread crumbs
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
- 4 cups water
Steps:
1. Flatten the chicken thighs and season with soy sauce and pepper.
2. Mix ground pork, ham, boiled egg, cheese, raisins, relish, raw egg, bread crumbs and salt.
3. Spread the stuffing on the chicken and roll tightly.
4. Wrap each roll in foil and twist the ends.
5. Boil in water for 1 hr 15 mins.
6. Cool, unwrap, slice and serve.

Short Description: Bite-sized chicken seared quickly with garlic, butter, soy, and Worcestershire, finished with spring onion.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Marinating Time: 15 minutes
Overall Time: 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 250 g boneless chicken thigh or breast, cut into bite-sized cubes
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped
- 1 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp cooking oil
- 1 spring onion, sliced
Steps:
1. Cut the chicken into even cubes and pat dry. Toss with soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper; marinate for 15 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Spread the chicken in one layer and sear for 3-4 minutes, turning so the pieces brown on more than one side and cook through.
3. Lower the heat. Add butter and garlic and sauté briefly until fragrant; do not burn the garlic.
4. Toss the chicken in the garlic butter for another 1-2 minutes, ensuring the thickest piece is fully cooked through.
5. Sprinkle with spring onion and serve hot with garlic rice.

Short Description: Sizzling chopped chicken with onions, chilies, and calamansi, a crunchy pulutan.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Overall Time: 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken thighs
- 1 piece chicken liver
- 1 medium red onion, chopped
- 2 pieces siling haba, chopped
- 1 piece siling labuyo, chopped
- 3 tbsp calamansi juice
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 pieces eggs
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Boil the chicken and liver for 15 minutes. Drain.
2. Grill or pan-fry the chicken until browned and crisp at the edges. Chop finely with the liver.
3. Saute onion and chilies in oil for 2 minutes.
4. Add the chopped chicken, soy sauce, calamansi juice, salt and pepper. Toss over high heat.
5. Stir in mayonnaise.
6. Serve on a hot plate topped with a raw or fried egg.

Short Description: Sweet cured chicken pan-fried until caramelized, a great breakfast with garlic rice.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 15 minutes
Curing Time: 8 hours
Overall Time: About 8 hours 25 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken breast, sliced thin
- 1/4 cup pineapple juice
- 3 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1/2 tsp annatto powder (for color)
- 3 tbsp cooking oil
- 1/4 cup water
Steps:
1. Combine pineapple juice, brown sugar, salt, soy sauce, garlic, pepper and annatto powder.
2. Add the chicken and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
3. Place the chicken with the marinade and water in a pan and simmer until the liquid is nearly gone.
4. Add oil and fry until caramelized on both sides.
5. Serve with garlic rice and fried egg.

Short Description: Crispy, juicy chicken marinated in soy sauce and calamansi, then deep-fried.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 30 minutes
Marinating Time: 1 hour
Overall Time: 1 hour 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 3 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp calamansi juice
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup cornstarch
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 cups cooking oil for frying
Steps:
1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce, calamansi juice, garlic and pepper for 1 hour.
2. Mix flour, cornstarch and salt in a bowl.
3. Dredge the chicken in the flour mixture, pressing to coat.
4. Fry in medium-hot oil for 15 to 18 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
5. Drain on paper towels and serve with banana ketchup.

Short Description: Crisp breaded chicken fillets served with a rich, creamy gravy.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cooking Time: 25 minutes
Overall Time: 40 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken breast fillets
- 1 piece egg, beaten
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup bread crumbs
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 1 cup cooking oil for frying
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour (for gravy)
- 1 cup chicken broth
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
Steps:
1. Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Coat in flour, dip in egg, then coat in bread crumbs.
2. Fry in hot oil for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden. Drain.
3. For the gravy, melt butter in a pan and stir in flour for 1 minute.
4. Gradually pour in the broth and soy sauce, stirring until thick and smooth.
5. Season with pepper, pour the gravy over the chicken and serve with rice.

Short Description: A sour chicken soup with tamarind leaves, tomatoes, and vegetables.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 40 minutes
Overall Time: 50 minutes
Ingredients:
- 2 pieces chicken (leg quarters), cut up
- 1 cup young tamarind (sampalok) leaves
- 1/4 cup tamarind pulp (or 1 pack sinigang mix)
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, quartered
- 1 piece tomato, quartered
- 2 pieces siling haba
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 4 cups water
- 1 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute ginger, onion and tomato in oil.
2. Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
3. Pour in water and tamarind pulp. Simmer covered for 30 minutes.
4. Add siling haba and fish sauce.
5. Add tamarind leaves and cook for 2 minutes. Serve hot.

Short Description: A traditional ginger-rich soup with free-range native chicken and green papaya.
Cooking Time:
Preparation Time: 10 minutes
Cooking Time: 1 hour 5 minutes
Overall Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Ingredients:
- 1/2 native chicken, cut up
- 1 small green papaya, wedged
- 1 thumb-sized ginger, sliced
- 1 medium onion, sliced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 1 handful chili leaves (dahon ng sili)
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 4 cups water
- 2 tbsp cooking oil
Steps:
1. Saute garlic, onion and ginger in oil.
2. Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes. Season with fish sauce.
3. Pour in water and simmer covered for 45 minutes until the native chicken is tender.
